name: B-Prime Direct
headline: B-Prime Direct
description: A modern B-complex with 10 B vitamins in highly bioavailable forms, to top up deficiencies and support the whole body. It comes as single-dose stick sachets of powder that dissolve in the mouth, with a citrus taste and no sugar.
howToUse: Adults – 1 stick sachet a day after food. Pour the contents straight into the mouth and let it dissolve before swallowing; no water needed.

manufacturing.expiration: 2 years from the date of manufacture
manufacturing.storage: Store in a dry place, protected from direct sunlight, out of reach of children, at a temperature not above +25°C.
manufacturing.ingredients: Sorbitol (sweetener), choline (choline citrate), inositol (myo-inositol), sodium chloride, vitamin B3 (niacinamide), orange flavouring, biotin (D-biotin), vitamin B5 (calcium D-pantothenate), vitamin B12 (methylcobalamin), vitamin B2 (sodium riboflavin 5'-phosphate), vitamin B1 (thiamine hydrochloride) and other B vitamins.
